rule: A row gets ok only from a current listing, its own site or recent reviews with nothing saying closed (docs/EATS.md). A row is taken out when a search could not find the place at all or the sources disagree; a place found but not freshly confirmed stays without ok.
scope: the six rows without ok; the eight rows already confirmed were not checked again

passes.how: Google Maps opened in headless Chromium, one place at a time. Maps showed a limited view (status, address, hours, phone, rating), without its reviews tab, so no review date could be read; a place with today's hours and no closed notice counts as a current listing
